item.title: Re: Doing something about this
item.content:encoded:
I like the changes, though I do have one major tip:

You use "he", "his", and "him" a lot - that needs to be changed. Try to make your language as cold and dehumanizing as possible. The Foundation does not view humanoid SCPs as people, but as dangerous objects in need of containment and study. Minimizing pronoun use in general how I generally try to work things, since "it" just doesn't read quite right, especially when used repeatedly. Using "SCP-182", "the subject", etc. keeps the tone cold and detached, though the occasional pronoun can fit in. You don't need to get rid of all personal pronouns, just keep them to a minimum when referring to the SCP.

item.title: Re: Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
Keep working on the rewrite and try it again sir. I upvoted the article in the hopes that it is not deleted, because I sincerely believe that this can be made into a good SCP. True, the previous version was quite horrible, but the recent rewrite by Kald saved much of it.

My recommendations:

  • Remove him from the boat and place him on an island. I'm sure that the Foundation has a small, uninhabited but surveyed island somewhere on the planet. There are literally hundreds in Canada.
  • The mindwipes are just laughable. We don't perform mindwipes of O-5 personnel on every other SCP, and this one should be no different. If we perform mindwipes of O-5 just in case they ever get captured, then we've got bigger problems to worry about.
  • Saint? Really? His name is Saint? *rolls eyes*
  • Lower his range.
  • The effect of his ability should be damaging to both the individuals around him and himself. I propose changing it so that his mind acts as sort of an informational blackhole. He absorbs memories, thoughts, and emotions from those around him. This will eventually render the victims catatonic, and the addition of so much conflicting information is slowly driving him insane.

My two cents. If this does get deleted, however, I will take my final idea and see if I can flesh out a new and better SCP for it. Good luck.
